description: This file is a shell script used for testing compatibility of object formats in git repositories, involving setup of repositories, creation of commits, tags, and verification of object identifiers across different hash functions.

methods.name: compat_hash
methods.description: Returns the corresponding hash algorithm for a given hash type (sha1 or sha256).

methods.name: hello_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for 'hello' based on the hash algorithm.

methods.name: tree_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for 'tree' based on the hash algorithm.

methods.name: commit_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for 'commit' based on the hash algorithm.

methods.name: commit2_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for 'commit2' based on the hash algorithm.

methods.name: del_sigcommit
methods.description: Deletes the signature from a commit object based on the specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: del_sigtag
methods.description: Deletes the signature from a tag object based on the specified storage and hash algorithm.

methods.name: compare_oids
methods.description: Compares object IDs, types, sizes, and contents between sha1 and sha256 versions of git objects to verify consistency.
